title: August 2026 Timic Recursive Formalisms
provenance_rule: These equations were developed in prior Tim Dooley / Potato of Life conversations. Where the equation was supplied by the assistant while formalizing Tim's ideas, it is labeled assistant-formalized rather than Tim-authored.

formalisms.name: Dooley state / greatness vector
formalisms.status: assistant-formalized around Timic concepts in prior conversation
formalisms.use: Treats Timic development as a multidimensional state rather than a single scalar rank.

formalisms.name: Monotonic development claim
formalisms.caution: A vector cannot be globally ordered without defining a partial/order relation or scalar objective. Future use should replace '>' with componentwise dominance, Pareto improvement or an explicit score functional.

formalisms.name: Recursive Dooley update
formalisms.interpretation: Next Timic state depends on prior state plus project/world/relationship/time-like inputs; the historical variable meanings should be recovered before canonical physical use.

formalisms.name: Potato root-sprout decomposition
formalisms.use: Minimal polarity between stored/anchored structure and directional emergence.

formalisms.name: Growth function
formalisms.caution: Not a biological growth law until variables and units are defined.

formalisms.name: Capacity feedback loop
formalisms.possible_math: C_(n+1)=C_n+ηG(L_n,C_n,...) as a later toy model only

formalisms.name: Energy-to-creation chain
formalisms.chain: Environment → Assimilation → Stored Energy → Work → Creation

formalisms.name: Error-correction / transformation chain
formalisms.chain: Flaw → Reflection → Understanding → Correction → Greater Form

formalisms.name: Potential-to-information loop
formalisms.chain: Potential → Labor → Fruit → Information → Improvement → Greater Potential

formalisms.name: Future reinterpretation loop
formalisms.boundary: Retrospective reinterpretation is not physical backward causation.

recommended_repairs: Replace vague scalar superiority D_(n+1)>D_n with a defined partial order or objective functional.
Recover meanings and units for P_n,W_n,R_n,T_n before using the recursive update as mathematics.
Distinguish causal biological chains from symbolic developmental chains.
Link the feedback loops to Potato Dynamics as candidate subsystems, not as new fundamental forces.
